text:
olivia_sales: Passing Pulseleaf (MidMarket, est. $85k ARR) to CS for activation. PO signed, target go-live 2026-04-07. Key blockers: SAML SSO not configured, custom embeddings API connector outstanding, and they want hosted first but may request private later. Kate (kate@pulseleaf.com) is the Okta admin.

olivia_sales: Quick note on attributes: they expect Okta to send email, firstName, lastName. Also asked about session timeout & SCIM later.

rahul_cs: I'll own onboarding. @devon_support please start the SSO setup (metadata exchange + test). @sasha_eng please evaluate the connector and confirm schema/headers needed. I'll book a 30m kickoff Thu 3pm PT and include Kate + our Solutions Eng.

devon_support: I'll open INF ticket and request IdP metadata + certificate. Do we have a sample SP metadata for Pulseleaf or should I ask Kate to share from her Okta app?

olivia_sales: Sharing SP metadata link from customer Okta now: https://okta.pulseleaf.com/admin/app/12345/sso/saml/metadata. They want attribute match on `email`.

sasha_eng: Noted. Clarifying: will traffic flow through hosted Redwood API for inference (yes?) or are they planning dedicated pools? That affects egress/CORS and header passthrough for the connector.

olivia_sales: Confirm hosted for initial ramp. SLA/Perf ask: ~200ms p95 for generation. Compliance: transcripts/token logs retained 365 days.

rahul_cs: Added compliance checkbox to the onboarding runbook. Action owners: 1) Devon 12 INF-XXXX create ticket + request metadata. 2) Sasha 12 review connector & post mapping notes (ETA 2-3bd). 3) Rahul 12 schedule kickoff Thu 3pm PT, add to CS dashboard. 4) Olivia 12 provide Okta contact and any test creds. Renewal status: 11 months out, set to Medium risk until usage ramps.

devon_support: INF-4601 created and linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4601. Pinged kate@pulseleaf.com for metadata and cert. Will attempt initial SAML assertion test within 24h of receipt.

sasha_eng: Preliminary review: connector likely needs JSON schema mapping for embeddings payload and an auth header passthrough. Initial PR + mapping notes in ~2 business days; if we need a CORS proxy for hosted flow, add ~1 extra day.

rahul_cs: Creating Gainsight record `pulseleaf-onboard-2026` to capture feature asks, docs gaps, and user feedback. I'll also add a renewal watch tag and SOP tasks for 30/60/90 day activation metrics.

olivia_sales: Customer expects to start inviting users within 2 weeks of SSO green. I'll be available for any contract clarifications. :thumbsup:

enablement_bot: Template `midmarket_sso_v1` applied to the onboarding checklist. Reminder: follow-up cadence set to 3 business days.
